title: libdictenstein Lua
summary: Mutable, immutable, and persistent dictionaries with snapshot iteration, substring indexing, and dictionary algebra for Lua 5.4.

examples.title: Dictionary construction, iteration, and algebra
examples.description: Build two dictionaries, preserve valueless membership, traverse an immutable revision, and union with an explicit mapped-value policy.

entries.name: abi_version
entries.description: Read the stable C ABI version for diagnostics and compatibility checks.

entries.name: api_revision
entries.description: Read the native API revision; optional facades must still negotiate their own support.

entries.name: dynamic_dawg
entries.description: Create a mutable DynamicDAWG; domain defaults to unicode and can also be byte or u64.

entries.name: double_array_trie
entries.description: Bulk-build an immutable double-array trie from byte or Unicode terms; u64 keys are unsupported.

entries.name: scdawg
entries.description: Create a mutable substring-indexed dictionary for byte or Unicode terms; u64 keys are unsupported.

entries.name: pathmap
entries.description: Explicitly reports UNSUPPORTED status 6; this Lua module does not link optional revision-8 PathMap symbols.

entries.name: suffix_index
entries.description: Explicitly reports UNSUPPORTED status 6; SCDAWG substring search is not a typed suffix-source snapshot.

entries.name: create_persistent_artrie
entries.description: Create a durable ARTrie for byte, Unicode, or u64 keys at path.

entries.name: open_persistent_artrie
entries.description: Reopen a durable ARTrie at path with the matching unit domain.

entries.name: create_persistent_vocabulary
entries.description: Create a durable Unicode vocabulary with reverse ID lookup.

entries.name: open_persistent_vocabulary
entries.description: Reopen a durable Unicode vocabulary at path.

entries.name: close
entries.description: Release the handle; repeated calls are harmless. A consumer that already retained the resource keeps its independent revision.

entries.name: len
entries.description: Count terminal terms in the current dictionary revision.

entries.name: kind
entries.description: Inspect backend kind: 1 DynamicDAWG, 2 DoubleArrayTrie, 3 SCDAWG, 4 ARTrie, 5 vocabulary.

entries.name: capabilities
entries.description: Inspect capability bits before using backend-specific mutation, substring, checkpoint, or compact operations.

entries.name: put
entries.description: Insert or update a byte/Unicode term; value may be nil, a nonnegative Lua integer, or a full-u64 decimal string.

entries.name: remove
entries.description: Remove a byte/Unicode term when the backend supports deletion.
entries.returns: Boolean: true if membership was removed.

entries.name: get
entries.description: Look up a byte/Unicode term without conflating valueless membership with absence or zero.

entries.name: contains
entries.description: Test byte/Unicode membership without retrieving a mapped value.

entries.name: put_u64
entries.description: Insert or update a u64-token key. Tokens and values above math.maxinteger are decimal strings.

entries.name: remove_u64
entries.description: Remove a u64-token key.

entries.name: get_u64
entries.description: Retrieve optional value for a u64-token key.

entries.name: contains_u64
entries.description: Test u64-token membership.

entries.name: term
entries.description: Reverse-lookup a string term by vocabulary ID; unsupported on other backends.

entries.name: entries
entries.description: Materialize one immutable lexicographically ordered snapshot. limits may set positive max_entries, max_units, and max_values.
entries.returns: Snapshot table with metadata and pairs(snapshot) yielding key, value, has_value.

entries.name: entry_cursor
entries.description: Open a bounded snapshot cursor with the same positive limits; close after early stop.

entries.name: entries_iter
entries.description: Create a Lua 5.4 generic-for iterator over one captured revision. The closing variable owns the cursor on break or error.

entries.name: algebra
entries.description: Apply union, intersection, difference, or symmetric_difference to independent input snapshots of the same unit domain.

entries.name: union
entries.description: Union of independent snapshots; default collision policy last/right.

entries.name: intersection
entries.description: Intersection of independent snapshots; default collision policy lattice_meet.

entries.name: difference
entries.description: Terms present in left but absent from right; values follow left.

entries.name: symmetric_difference
entries.description: Terms present in exactly one input snapshot; values follow their source side.

entries.name: clear
entries.description: Remove all terms when the backend advertises clear capability.

entries.name: compact
entries.description: Reclaim obsolete representation space when supported; not a durability checkpoint.

entries.name: checkpoint
entries.description: Flush a persistent backend to its durable checkpoint when supported.

entries.name: contains_substring
entries.description: Test substring occurrence in an SCDAWG dictionary.

entries.name: frequency
entries.description: Count substring occurrences in an SCDAWG dictionary.

protocols.name: local dictionary <close> = ...
protocols.description: Lua 5.4 lexical cleanup deterministically closes dictionary and entry-cursor userdata; __gc is only a fallback.

protocols.name: cursor:next()
protocols.description: Returns key, value, has_value, or no values at end. Metadata includes unit_domain, value_domain, optional exact_length and snapshot_identity.

protocols.name: for key, value, has_value in dictionary:entries_iter() do
protocols.description: The fourth generic-for result is a Lua 5.4 closing cursor, so early break and errors release the snapshot.

protocols.name: pairs(dictionary:entries())
protocols.description: Iterate a materialized immutable snapshot in native lexicographic order.

protocols.name: left | right; left & right; left - right; left ~ right
protocols.description: Operator aliases for union, intersection, difference, and symmetric difference, with the corresponding default value policies.

protocols.name: first / last / lattice_join / lattice_meet
protocols.description: Optional-u64 collision policy for keys present in both inputs; valueless membership is distinct from absence.
